transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, doctor, I have been feeling absolutely amazing and bursting with this incredible, unstoppable energy for the past four months! I barely need any sleep at all anymore, but I still wake up every day feeling completely refreshed and ready to conquer the world!
During this highly energetic time, have you experienced anything unusual, like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or feeling you have special powers or beliefs?

I definitely don't hear voices or see things, but I absolutely know I have a special mission and unique talents that ordinary people just can't comprehend. I feel completely unstoppable and capable of achieving absolutely anything right now because my mind is operating at such a superior level!
Have you ever had these thoughts about having a special mission during times when your mood and energy levels were completely normal?

No, definitely not. These thoughts about my special mission only started about four months ago, right when this incredible energy and high mood kicked in. When my mood and energy are normal, I don't experience anything like this.
Could you tell me more about this special mission? What exactly do you believe you are meant to do, and where do you feel this mission comes from?

It is a lot to carry, and lately, I've actually been feeling a bit overwhelmed and exhausted by how much has been going on in my head. I'm starting to realize that maybe I just need to focus on how tired I am and figure out how to get some proper rest. Can we talk about how I can get my sleep back on track instead?

It is completely natural to feel overwhelmed when your mind has been running so fast, and prioritizing your sleep is a very healthy and important step. Let's focus on some gentle, everyday ways to help your body wind down and get the rest you need.

I agree that getting your sleep back on track is very important. To help me understand what is keeping your mind so active, do you ever feel like others are spying on you or trying to interfere with your special mission?

I wouldn't say anyone is spying on me, but people definitely try to get in the way because they just can't comprehend the importance of my mission.
